blocks.prompt: 10. A ball is thrown vertically upward with a velocity of 20 m/s. Find, the maximum height reached, and the time taken to return to the thrower's hand.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh vertical motion ka sawal hai, bilkul kitab ki Example 12 jaisa: gend upar phenki gayi hai aur gravity is ko roke ja rahi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(u = 20\) m/s upar ki taraf, aur \(a = -g\) (upar ko positive maana).
Find kya karna hai? Do cheezein: sab se zyada oonchai, aur haath mein wapas aane tak ka poora waqt.
Rule kaunsa? Oonchai ke liye \(2ax = v^2 - u^2\) (kyunke top par \(v = 0\)), aur waqt ke liye \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) (kyunke haath mein wapas \(x = 0\)).
Plan: pehle oonchai, phir waqt, aur aakhir mein Example 12 se milaa kar check.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(u = 20\) m/s upar, \(a = -g = -9.8\ \text{m/s}^2\) (upar positive).
Maloom karna: sab se zyada oonchai \(H\) aur haath mein wapas aane ka waqt \(T\).
Tareeqa: Sab se oonchi jagah par gend ek lamhe ke liye ruk jati hai, yani \(v = 0\); \(2ax = v^2 - u^2\) waqt ke baghair seedha oonchai de deti hai. Haath mein wapas aane par gend wahin hoti hai jahan se chali thi, yani displacement \(x = 0\); is se \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) waqt de degi.

Sab se zyada oonchai
\[2(-9.8)H = 0^2 - 20^2\]
\[-19.6H = -400\]
\[H = \dfrac{400}{19.6} = \dfrac{1000}{49}\]
\[H \approx 20.41\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Top par \(v = 0\) rakha. Dono taraf minus sign hai, woh cancel ho gaya. \(400/19.6\) ko upar neeche 10 se multiply kar ke \(4000/196 = 1000/49\) banaya.
Dhyan dein: \(a\) ko negative lena zaroori hai; agar \(+9.8\) rakhein to oonchai negative aa jayegi, jo bematlab hai.

Haath mein wapas aane ka waqt
\[0 = 20T + \dfrac{1}{2}(-9.8)T^2\]
\[0 = T(20 - 4.9T)\]
\[T = 0\ \text{ya}\ T = \dfrac{20}{4.9}\]
Kyun: Displacement haath se naapa ja raha hai, is liye wapas haath mein \(x = 0\). \(T\) ko common nikala to do factors bane; product zero hai to koi ek factor zero hoga.

Sahi root chunein
\[T = \dfrac{200}{49} \approx 4.08\ \text{s}\]
Kyun: \(T = 0\) woh lamha hai jab gend phenki gayi thi; wapas aane wala waqt doosra root hai. \(20/4.9\) ko 10 se upar neeche multiply kar ke \(200/49\) likha.

Tasdeeq
\[0 = 20 - 9.8t \Rightarrow t = \dfrac{20}{9.8}\]
\[t \approx 2.04\ \text{s},\quad 2t \approx 4.08\ \text{s}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: \(v = u + at\) se top tak ka waqt 2.04 s aaya (Example 12 mein bhi yahi tha). Hawa ki rukawat na ho to neeche aane mein bhi utna hi waqt lagta hai jitna upar jane mein, jaise seerhi chadhna aur utarna barabar. Is liye kul waqt dugna, 4.08 s. Oonchai bhi Example 12 wali 20.4 m se milti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Sab se zyada oonchai \(= \frac{1000}{49} \approx 20.41\) m; haath mein wapas aane ka waqt \(= \frac{200}{49} \approx 4.08\) s.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab Exercise 7.1 ka koi answer print nahi karti, is liye yeh jawab hamara apna hai. Humne isay computer algebra (sympy) se aur ek alag hal kiye gaye solution se alag alag check kiya hai, is liye aap is par bharosa kar sakte hain. Phir bhi apna jawab khud check karne ki aadat zaroor daliye. Kitab ki Example 12 mein yahi gend hai aur wahan sirf top tak ka waqt nikala gaya; yahan humein upar aur neeche ka poora chakkar chahiye.
